fact: SONNA reports that Somalia's Upper House passed the third reading of the National Payment System Bill on 11 January 2026 by 28 votes to none, with no abstentions; the article does not say it has been signed or is in force.

Gole Kaab reports that the House of the People passed the National Payment System Bill on 8 November 2025 with 154 votes in favour and 2 abstentions, sending it to the Upper House; the bill would empower the Central Bank of Somalia to license and supervise payment systems, digital money platforms and other financial service providers.

The Central Bank of Somalia made the Mobile Money Regulations, Amended 2020 (CBS/NBS/REG/06), under the Central Bank of Somalia Act 2012, setting out licensing, conduct of business and supervision of mobile money service providers; the document is dated 2020 and states no end date.
